text_blocks.snippet: For gym beginners in India, the best approach is to start with a high-quality Whey Protein Concentrate or a Concentrate-Isolate Blend. These forms are budget-friendly, easily digestible, and provide all the essential amino acids needed for muscle recovery. Top recommended brands include MuscleBlaze, Optimum Nutrition (ON), and Nakpro.
When you are starting out, you do not need highly advanced or expensive hydrolysed proteins. Instead, prioritize a product that focuses on easy digestion, lab-tested purity, and clear labeling.

text_blocks.snippet: 💡 Beginner Guide: What to Look For

list.snippet: Digestion Strategy: If you have never taken whey before, look for brands containing added digestive enzymes (like DigeZyme). This drastically reduces the initial gas or heavy-stomach feeling.

Authenticity Verification: Fake supplements are a concern in India. Always buy from authorized brand webstores or certified platforms like HealthKart or official brand portals. Ensure you scratch and verify the authenticity code on the tub before consuming.

Lactose Sensitivity: Normal whey concentrate contains small amounts of lactose. If you are heavily lactose intolerant, skip concentrate and start straight with a Whey Protein Isolate (like Isopure or MuscleBlaze Iso-Zero) or go for a plant-based alternative.
